description: This Java class 'ModifyResourcesStrategy' handles the 'ModifyResources' command in a policy management system. It performs operations to modify resources within a policy, including size validation, resource removal, validation, and event creation.

classes.name: ModifyResourcesStrategy
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractPolicyCommandStrategy that handles the 'ModifyResources' command by modifying resources within a policy, validating size, and generating appropriate events.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Performs the resource modification logic including resource removal, size validation, and event creation. Returns a Result object indicating success or failure.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the EntityTag of the previous policy's resources if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the EntityTag of the new resources post-modification.
